title: SMBIOS Type 17 widths hardcoded to 72
description: The populated-DIMM branch hardcodes total width 72 and data width 72. A live MR9A capture confirms 72/72.
remediation: Complete DDR3/DDR4 width decoder from the existing SPD-width HOB byte. C1 local, C2 loader/physical. Handles ECC, non-ECC, unknown and empty slots. The PE grows by 160 bytes; ROM fit is untested.
